mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Gorehorn Raider: "Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, this creature
# deals 2 damage to any target."
# Raid is an ability word (CR 207.2c). Event and intervening "if": the compiler's own raid frame
# (`parse "Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, look at the top three cards
# of your library."`, B13-etb+if: TURN_OF you and EVENT_THIS_TURN over a DeclareAttackersEvent),
# the frame FDN Gutless Plunderer keeps. Effect: M21 Skeleton Archer's / Meteorite's verified
# "it deals N damage to any target" (B2a-skeleton-archer) with 2; the source deals it.
raid = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(
                pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
                count=QConst(value=1),
                event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAnd(children=())),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=2),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FOr(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Player'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [raid, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
clauses.evidence: Tree is the compiler's own Raid shape: ZoneChangeEvent(IS_SOURCE) with condition FAnd(TURN_OF YOU, EVENT_THIS_TURN count 1 DeclareAttackersEvent), DEAL_DAMAGE 2 to a TARGET Selector over FOr(Creature, Planeswalker, Player). The probe never attacks before the Raider enters: the [cast] and 'enters during the opponent's turn' variants show no trigger, and no later stimulus re-enters it, so the trigger, its target slot and its damage are never seen. Packs: H01_1 (2 damage to a creature, raid on), H01_2 (a player), H01_5 (a planeswalker loses 2 loyalty), H01_3 (no attack: nothing), H01_4 (only the opponent attacked: nothing).
